attribution.note: Marcus directly asserts the necessary condition; he is not merely quoting OpenAI's forecast.

semantics.note: The proposition preserves the firm conditional: without sustained large-business revenue growth, OpenAI will miss its revenue target.

contract.note: The surrounding passage reasonably supplies the approximate $200 billion target and calendar 2030 horizon. Sustained growth is an ordinary reading, though segment boundaries and the numerical mismatch remain interpretive.

evidence.note: This dated company disclosure describes revenue channels. It establishes neither realized 2030 revenue nor the absence of sustained large-business revenue growth.

reviews.rationale: The deadline remains ahead, the conditional antecedent is unknown, and no qualifying early-resolution event is documented. Other revenue channels do not establish that OpenAI can achieve the target without sustained large-business growth.
